description: Defines the IOutput interface and related enums for Dolby output configuration within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IOutput
classes.description: Interface for Dolby output settings and notifications, including sound modes, Atmos metadata, and mode configuration.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for Dolby output events, such as audio mode changes.

methods.name: AtmosMetadata
methods.description: Checks if Atmos metadata is supported.

methods.name: EnableAtmosOutput
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos audio output.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Sets or gets the Dolby mode.
